record.one_liner: Global network and developer platform (CDN, DNS, security, Workers, storage) managed through a public REST API.
record.auth_notes: Documented credentials are API tokens (user or account-owned) and the legacy Global API Key. No OAuth flow for third-party apps was seen in the fetched docs. Origin CA keys are also listed but are not a third-party API credential.
record.access_notes: Tokens are created by the account holder in the dashboard. The fetched pages show no paid or trial gate on token creation, but I did not fetch a pricing page to confirm free-plan availability.
record.api_notes: Official MCP README claims the API covers about 2,500 endpoints. Endpoints are described with path, query and body parameters, which is consistent with a REST-style API. The docs page did not use the word REST, so api_style is inferred.
